display_name: EuroQol- 5 Dimension (EQ-5D): Visual analogue scale (VAS), "Your Health Today" (range: 0-100)
description:
Item from EuroQol- 5 Dimension (EQ-5D), a five-dimension descriptive system to assess generic-quality of life. Higher scores indicate better health. A 10-point change is often considered clinically meaningful. [EuroQol Research Foundation. EQ-5D-3L User Guide, 2018.](https://euroqol.org/publications/user-guides)

[Search for all EQ-5D variables within this dataset](https://sleepdata.org/loftdatasets/lofthf/variables?search=eq5d)
